letter.role_title: Working Student - Generative AI & Data Analytics (m/f/d)
letter.greeting: Dear Allianz Kunde und Markt GmbH team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Generative AI & Data Analytics. Applying AI and data analytics to real customer and market questions at Allianz is a strong fit with my AI degree and my industry analytics experience.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, where I built computer vision and NLP projects in PyTorch. I also bring industry experience in SQL, data pipelines and dashboards from SAP data & analytics work.

achievements.impact: I built a PyTorch retinal OCT classifier on EfficientNet-B0 reaching 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
in a team project I compared language-model representations (BERT, GPT-2) and graph embeddings for clustering text
I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement

letter.problems_section: I would contribute solid Python and SQL, a good understanding of how language models work and where they fail, and the ability to explain results clearly. Building AI agents in a production team would be new for me, and I am motivated to learn it quickly.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Munich. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
